followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the Portugal–Spain COVID formal policy period; the sources establish the restrictions and completed formal lifting ceremony. Maintain nine authorized crossings and the stated goods, worker, returnee and essential-case exemptions. The episode is not an absolute prohibition on all road or rail movement. Retain 23:00 Portuguese time on 16 March to the 1 July 2020 formal endpoint, with 107 calendar days. The Spanish calendar boundary is 17 March; date arithmetic is not elapsed hours or first observed ordinary passage. Retain Health and biosecurity / Human disease control from the bilateral COVID policy purpose. The Portuguese announcement, joint declaration and Spanish account are official policy evidence with different document functions. They do not independently monitor continuous operations at every post. Retain unlocated bilateral policy scope with null coordinates and formal-policy temporal treatment. No continuously closed full-frontier line is inferred from the authorized-crossing regime.
